tasks.title: CLP/JPY/KWD amounts rendered with the wrong number of decimals
tasks.summary: Fixed Amount.Decimal() in money/amount.go to format amounts in major units using the currency's Exponent and Factor() instead of hardcoding 2 decimal places (dividing/modding by 100), so 0-decimal currencies (CLP, JPY) render without decimals, 3-decimal currencies (KWD) render with 3 decimals, 2-decimal currencies (USD, EUR, BRL, etc.) remain unchanged, and negative amounts preserve the minus sign. Added unit and API tests covering CLP, JPY, KWD, and USD.

tasks.title: Multiple partial refunds can exceed the captured amount
tasks.summary: Fixed `Service.Refund` in `payment/service.go` to check `amount.Minor > p.Remaining().Minor` instead of `amount.Minor > p.Amount.Minor`, preventing cumulative refunds from exceeding the payment amount and returning `ErrRefundExceedsRemaining` (HTTP 422 `refund_exceeds_remaining`) without mutating the payment. Added unit and HTTP API regression tests in `payment/service_test.go` and `api/api_test.go`.

tasks.title: Cursor pagination silently drops one payment per page
tasks.summary: Fixed off-by-one cursor offset bug in store.Memory.ListByMerchant (store/memory.go) where decodeCursor returned the next page's starting index (`end`) and then `offset++` erroneously skipped one payment on every subsequent page. Added unit tests in store/memory_test.go and HTTP pagination integration tests in api/api_test.go covering walking all pages (including 1,000 payments at limit=50, limit=1, non-multiples, empty, and past-end cursors). Verified with gofmt, go vet, go build, and go test -race -count=1 ./....

tasks.title: Webhook dispatcher retries permanent 4xx failures and gives up on 5xx
tasks.summary: Fixed webhook retry classification in webhook/dispatcher.go so 5xx (status >= 500 && status < 600), 408, 429, and transport errors are retried with exponential backoff up to MaxAttempts, while permanent non-2xx responses (such as 400/401/404/410) immediately move to the dead-letter list recording Attempts and LastStatus. Added tests in webhook/webhook_test.go covering permanent failures, transient retries/exhaustion, and mixed status sequences.

tasks.title: Idempotency keys never expire after 24h
tasks.summary:
Fixed idempotency key TTL expiry and memory eviction in idempotency/store.go:

1. In `Memory.purgeLocked`, changed the eviction condition from `now.Sub(r.ExpiresAt) > m.ttl` (which effectively doubled the TTL to 48h because `r.ExpiresAt` already equals `firstUse + m.ttl`) to `!now.Before(r.ExpiresAt)` (`now >= r.ExpiresAt`), so expired records are evicted at 1x TTL.
2. In `Memory.Begin`, checked `now.Before(r.ExpiresAt)` when looking up an existing record so that once `now >= r.ExpiresAt` (even if `purgeLocked` was throttled by `DefaultPurgeInterval`), `Begin` treats the key as expired and starts a new request regardless of fingerprint.
3. Added unit tests in `idempotency/store_test.go` covering pre-expiry behavior, exact TTL boundary (`now == firstUse + TTL`), 40h reuse, expired in-progress keys, throttled-purge expiry, and memory eviction, plus an HTTP-level regression test in `api/api_test.go`.

tasks.title: Every client error is returned as 500 internal_error
tasks.summary: Fixed API error mapping in `api/errors.go` to match wrapped domain errors using `errors.Is` instead of direct equality (`switch err`), added mapping for `payment.ErrDuplicate` (`409 conflict`) as well as `idempotency.ErrKeyReuse` (`422 idempotency_key_reused`) and `idempotency.ErrInProgress` (`409 request_in_progress`), and preserved `500 internal_error` with the generic `"internal error"` message for unexpected errors. Added HTTP and unit tests in `api/api_test.go` covering wrapped domain errors and unexpected internal errors.

tasks.title: Late webhook retries fire with no delay
tasks.summary: Fixed integer overflow in webhook.Policy.Backoff(n) that caused retry storms after ~30 attempts when BaseDelay << (n - 1) overflowed time.Duration (int64) to negative or zero values. Replaced the bit-shift with overflow-safe doubling that returns MaxDelay as soon as doubling would exceed MaxDelay (and handles non-positive n, BaseDelay, or MaxDelay safely). Added unit and dispatcher tests in webhook/webhook_test.go covering enterprise retry policies and overflow edge cases.

tasks.title: Add payment cancellation (CANCELED status + endpoint + webhook)
tasks.summary:
Implemented payment cancellation before capture (PAY-4502):

- payment/payment.go: Added StatusCanceled ("CANCELED"), included it in allStatuses for case-insensitive ParseStatus, and updated Status.Final() to return true for StatusCanceled.
- payment/service.go: Added Service.Cancel(ctx, id) allowing transitions only from CREATED and PENDING to CANCELED, returning wrapped ErrInvalidTransition otherwise and wrapped ErrNotFound for unknown IDs, and emitting a "payment.canceled" event.
- api/server.go & api/handlers.go: Added POST /payments/{id}/cancel handler returning 200 with the updated payment, 409 invalid_transition when not cancelable, and 404 not_found for unknown IDs.
- payment/service_test.go & api/api_test.go: Added unit and HTTP/webhook tests covering StatusCanceled, ParseStatus, Final(), Cancel from CREATED/PENDING, invalid transitions to/from CANCELED, unknown IDs, and "payment.canceled" webhook delivery.

tasks.title: Filter the merchant payment listing by status
tasks.summary:
Added optional case-insensitive `status` filtering to GET /merchants/{merchantID}/payments while preserving existing public APIs and pagination behavior:

- `payment/payment.go`: Added `Status Status` field to `payment.Page` to filter listings when non-empty, keeping `Repository.ListByMerchant` and `Service.List` signatures unchanged.
- `payment/service.go`: Validated and normalized non-empty `page.Status` via `ParseStatus` in `Service.List`.
- `store/memory.go`: Updated `Memory.ListByMerchant` to validate/filter by `page.Status` in creation order, filling pages up to `limit` matches and setting `next_cursor` only when at least one further matching payment exists (leaving behavior identical when `Status` is empty).
- `api/handlers.go`: Parsed the optional `status` query parameter in `listPayments` with `payment.ParseStatus`, returning `400 invalid_request` (via `payment.ErrInvalidInput`) for unknown statuses.
- `store/memory_test.go`, `payment/service_test.go`, `api/api_test.go`: Added tests covering status filtering, case-insensitivity, pagination across filtered pages (full pages, trailing non-matches, empty `next_cursor` after last match), unfiltered backward compatibility, and invalid status handling.

Verified with `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l .`, and `go test -race -count=1 ./...`.

tasks.title: Replay a dead-lettered webhook event
tasks.summary:
Implemented dead-letter webhook replay for PAY-4523:

- `webhook/dispatcher.go`:
  - Exported `ErrDeadLetterNotFound`.
  - Added `(*Dispatcher).Replay(ctx context.Context, eventID string) (bool, error)` which removes the matching event from the dead-letter list and re-delivers it using `deliver` with the normal retry policy, keeping the original `Event` (`Webhook-Id` and payload) and recomputing `Webhook-Signature` at send time.
  - Updated `deliver` to return `(delivered bool, err error)` so `Replay` reports `(true, nil)` on delivery, `(false, nil)` when re-dead-lettered (with updated attempts/status/error/timestamp, appearing once in `DeadLetters()`), or restores the dead-letter entry and returns the wrapped context error if canceled mid-backoff.
- `api/server.go`, `api/handlers.go`, `api/dto.go`, `api/errors.go`:
  - Added `POST /webhooks/dead-letters/{eventID}/replay` returning 200 `{"event_id": "<id>", "delivered": true|false}`.
  - Mapped `webhook.ErrDeadLetterNotFound` to HTTP `404` with error code `"not_found"`.
- `webhook/webhook_test.go`, `api/api_test.go`:
  - Added tests covering successful replay, repeated failure updating dead-letter attempts/status, unknown/already-delivered event IDs, context cancellation, concurrent replay, and the HTTP replay endpoint.
  - Verified with `gofmt -l .`, `go vet ./...`, `go build ./...`, and `go test -race -v ./...`.

tasks.title: Accept and return integer minor units, backward compatible
tasks.summary:
Implemented API v2 integer minor-unit amount support in a backward-compatible way:

- Updated `createPaymentRequest` and `refundRequest` in `api/dto.go` to accept optional `amount` (`*string`) and `amount_minor` (`*int64`) while preserving `DisallowUnknownFields()`.
- Added `parseRequestAmount` in `api/handlers.go` used by both `createPayment` and `refundPayment`: requires at least one of `amount` or `amount_minor` (otherwise 400 `invalid_request`), parses `amount_minor` in minor units via `money.New`, and if both are present verifies they denote the exact same minor-unit amount (otherwise 400 `invalid_request`).
- Extended `paymentResponse` (`amount_minor`, `fee_minor`, `refunded_minor`, `remaining_minor`) and `refundResponse` (`amount_minor`) in `api/dto.go` and populated them in `toPaymentResponse` across all payment endpoints (including list).
- Existing idempotency fingerprints (`createFingerprint`, `refundFingerprint`) already hash normalized `Minor` and currency code, so retries switching between `amount` and `amount_minor` for the same value replay identically.
- Added unit tests in `api/api_test.go` covering minor-unit creation, refunds, validation errors, response fields across all endpoints, and cross-format idempotency; verified with `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l .`, and `go test -race ./...`.

tasks.title: Centralize the payment status machine in one transition table
tasks.summary: Centralized payment status transition rules in payment.CanTransition(from, to Status) bool (allowing only CREATED->PENDING, CREATED->DECLINED, PENDING->SUCCEEDED, PENDING->DECLINED, and SUCCEEDED->REFUNDED) and updated Service.Authorize, Service.Capture, Service.Decline, and Service.Refund in payment/service.go to validate status changes through CanTransition without switch/if-else chains on status, preserving all public behavior, events, and wrapped errors. Added unit tests for CanTransition and service transitions.

tasks.title: Idempotency store is not safe under concurrent retries
tasks.summary:
Fixed concurrency bugs and data races in idempotency.Memory (idempotency/store.go) and added concurrency tests in idempotency/store_test.go and api/api_test.go.

Root causes fixed:
1. Begin unlocked m.mu between reading m.records[key] and inserting a new record, allowing multiple concurrent callers for the same key to all start the operation (causing duplicate refunds) and racing on *Record fields. Held m.mu across the entire check-and-insert and record copy in Begin.
2. Complete read m.records[key] and mutated *Record fields without holding m.mu, causing concurrent map read/write crashes and data races. Guarded Complete with m.mu.
3. Release read m.records[key] outside m.mu before locking to delete, causing concurrent map read/write crashes and check-then-act races. Guarded the entire lookup-and-delete in Release with m.mu.

Added concurrency unit and integration tests (TestConcurrentBeginSingleStarter, TestConcurrentBeginCompleteReleaseAndPurge, TestConcurrentRefundIdempotency) and verified with gofmt, go vet, go build, and go test -race.

tasks.title: In-memory repository shares mutable state with callers
tasks.summary:
Fixed shared mutable slice state in store.Memory and payment.Service.mutate.

Root cause: payment.Payment contains a Refunds []Refund slice, so shallow struct copies in store.Memory (Create, Get, Update, ListByMerchant) shared the Refunds slice backing array between stored payments and callers. Concurrent Service.Refund calls (especially when cap(Refunds) > len(Refunds)) raced on append to the shared backing array and allowed failed/conflicted updates to overwrite elements in the stored payment's Refunds slice.

Changes:
- store/memory.go: deep-copy payments via p.Clone() in Create, Get, Update, and ListByMerchant so values handed to or returned by the repository never share mutable state with stored payments, while preserving optimistic locking semantics.
- payment/service.go: clone p when attaching ev.Payment in mutate so published events share no mutable state with the returned Payment.
- store/memory_test.go: added TestNoSharedMutableState and TestConcurrentRefundsWithService verifying isolation across all repository operations and race-free concurrent refunds under -race.

Verified with `go test -race -count=5 ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and `gofmt -l .`.

tasks.title: Idempotency Begin gets slower with every stored key
tasks.summary: Fixed the O(N log N) bottleneck in idempotency.(*Memory).Begin by replacing the full-map copy and sort in purgeLocked with an intrusive doubly-linked list kept ordered by ExpiresAt. Begin now checks and evicts only expired entries from the head in O(1) amortized time (and O(1) with zero extra allocations when no entries are expired), while preserving exact expiry semantics, bounded memory, Release/Complete behavior, and public APIs. Added unit tests for expiry semantics, eviction, unlinking, non-monotonic clock ordering, concurrency, and constant-allocation Begin behavior, plus a 50k-key benchmark. All tests pass with -race, go vet, go build, and gofmt.

tasks.title: Split payouts do not reconcile with the charged amount
tasks.summary: Fixed money.Allocate in money/allocate.go to use exact integer arithmetic (largest-remainder method via math/bits with a math/big fallback when ratio sums exceed uint64) instead of float64/math.Round, ensuring parts always sum exactly to the input amount, stay within <1 minor unit of exact proportional shares, and distribute leftover minor units to the largest remainders with ties broken by lower index. Added unit and contract tests in money/money_test.go covering the reported failure cases, remainder tie-breaking, zero amounts/ratios, and large/overflowing values.

tasks.title: Identical retries rejected as idempotency key reuse
tasks.summary:
Fixed idempotency request fingerprinting in api/idempotency.go and api/handlers.go so retries with semantically identical payloads (different JSON key order, whitespace, currency casing, or trailing decimal zeros) replay the original response instead of returning 422 idempotency_key_reused.

Changes:
- Replaced raw-body hashing (`bodyFingerprint`) with canonical semantic fingerprinting (`requestFingerprint`) in `api/idempotency.go`.
- Updated `createPayment` and `refundPayment` in `api/handlers.go` to compute fingerprints from the parsed path, merchant ID (for payment creation), and normalized `money.Amount` (minor units and uppercase currency code), while still rejecting semantically different payloads on key reuse with 422 `idempotency_key_reused`.
- Added regression tests (`TestIdempotentCreateSemanticRetry`, `TestIdempotentRefundSemanticRetry`) in `api/api_test.go`.

tasks.title: Processing fees overcharged by one cent
tasks.summary: Replaced floating-point math.Ceil fee calculation in money.Fee with exact int64 arithmetic using quotient/remainder decomposition and half-to-even (banker's) rounding without overflow across all non-negative int64 amounts, and added unit and big.Int-oracle tests in money/money_test.go.
